items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern, with reports highlighting an increasing volume of fraudulent websites and scam operations targeting everyday users. Australian staff should remain cautious when clicking links in emails or messages, particularly from unfamiliar sources. Separately, a data breach at Scotland's prosecution office serves as a reminder that even government organisations are vulnerable — reinforcing the importance of strong data handling practices here at home.

A useful security principle to keep in mind: limiting who can access which parts of your organisation's systems reduces the damage any single breach can cause. **Tip:** If you don't need access to a system for your role, ask your IT team to remove it — less access means less risk.

featured.title: Global Threat Campaign Hits Critical VMware vCenter Flaw
featured.quote: Critical VMware vulnerability actively exploited globally, threatening Australian enterprises relying on vCenter infrastructure.
